name: Razormaw Needling
objectiveText: Collect 10 Razormaw Incisors for Howin Kindfeather . Razormaw Incisor  ( 10 )

comments.body:
I picked this up without any prerequisites as well.

Both this quest and [quest=98246] can be completed either in the west [i]or[/i] east of the zone. The western location only has [b]a few[/b] viable spawns for incisors, but [b]a lot[/b] of eggs and lower level raptors that you can often avoid aggroing while looting eggs. If you happen to be in the western half of the map, consider just finishing the egg part there. For [quest=98245], you really want to go east to around [b]69, 31[/b], as the teeth only drop well there. Watch out for [npc=1140] in the cave.

I also did [b]not[/b] receive any reputation with the Wildhammer Clan for completing this quest at 30.
Was able to pick this quest up without doing the two quests wowhead shows as prereqs on the Beta at level 21.
